name: B. N. Rathi Securities Limited
about: B. N. Rathi Securities Limited, together with its subsidiary, engages in the stock, currency, and commodity broking business in India. It provides margin trading facility, as well as depository services; and distributes mutual funds to its clients. The company was formerly known as Lark Leasing Limited and changed its name to B.N. Rathi Securities Limited in 1994. B. N. Rathi Securities Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
